reason: The ground truth states closeMenu never removes the document click listener (onClickOutside) added by openMenu, causing listeners to accumulate/persist and keep firing on subsequent clicks. The reviewer's finding identifies the exact same root cause: closeMenu removes the keydown listener but omits document.removeEventListener('click', onClickOutside), leaving the click listener permanently attached after first open, causing it to re-fire on every subsequent click. Both pinpoint the same missing cleanup call at the same location with the same runtime consequence (stale/accumulating click listener firing repeatedly). The reviewer additionally traces a downstream consequence (focus stealing via toggleEl.focus()), but this is an elaboration of the same mechanism, not a different bug.
